name: aiforging
description: AI Forging — a structured framework for teams building software with AI. A shared forge workspace, committed to git, lets a team run test-first development with one scoped suite per feature, pattern-driven refactoring, and domain-driven architecture — and lets any engineer resume a feature another one started. Plus optional post-build verification: browser testing against a human QA checklist, and a review/triage/fix loop.
